execution_policy.meaning: These are first-party-documented handoff recipes. They do not authorize a licensed command, add guard support, or prove compatibility.

recipes.purpose: Run one already-audited Gaussian input using the documented basename interface.
preconditions: Exact Gaussian 16 revision, entitlement, platform support, shell setup, and scratch policy are attested
job-name.gjf bytes and resource request are audited and authorized
job-name.log and checkpoint destinations do not alias evidence inputs
success_signals: matching Gaussian 16 revision in bound output
failure_semantics: Any missing identity/authorization blocks launch
Error termination, nonzero platform exit, revision mismatch, or incomplete task blocks acceptance
Output-file existence alone is not success
recipes.restart_semantics: Do not rerun blindly over prior outputs; choose the documented task-specific restart only after binding parent artifacts.
scientific_acceptance: Apply the selected task profile
Convergence and model-chemistry adequacy remain independent

recipes.purpose: Run one already-audited input with explicit stdin/stdout file binding.
preconditions: All basename-recipe environment, entitlement, input, output, and authorization gates pass
failure_semantics: A partial redirected log may exist after failure
Shell success and Gaussian technical completion must be recorded separately
recipes.restart_semantics: Preserve the failed log and checkpoint identities; restart into new bound outputs.
scientific_acceptance: Never accept from process status alone

recipes.purpose: Evaluate one declared electronic state at one immutable geometry with an explicit model chemistry.
preconditions: Structure, charge, multiplicity, method, basis/ECP, grid, solvent and target observable are explicit
The selected method-specific energy and convergence evidence are defined before execution

required_route_tokens: SP or no other job-type keyword

expected_outputs: method-specific final energy and requested properties
failure_semantics: An empty-route provider default is not an accepted scientific plan
SCF or correlated-solver failure, wrong state, missing property or detached geometry blocks use
recipes.restart_semantics: Preserve the failed run; use SCF/Guess restart only with exact compatible checkpoint records and a new authorized output.
scientific_acceptance: Converge method, basis/ECP, grid, solvent and geometry choices for the observable
A single point establishes neither a stationary geometry nor a stable/global electronic state

recipes.purpose: Optimize one local-minimum candidate while preserving coordinate, constraint, Hessian and state evidence.
preconditions: Initial structure and electronic state are plausible and hash-bound
Optimization goal, coordinate system, constraints, convergence policy and model chemistry are explicit
success_signals: SCF/state convergence at every accepted step
failure_semantics: MaxCycles exhaustion, coordinate/Hessian pathology, SCF failure, constraint mismatch or wrong stationary target blocks completion
Optimization completion alone does not identify a minimum
recipes.restart_semantics: Use Opt=Restart with the exact parent checkpoint, original optimization intent and a new immutable output; reapply every final gate.
scientific_acceptance: Run a same-model frequency analysis
Search relevant conformer, protonation and spin alternatives before a global-minimum claim

recipes.purpose: Characterize a same-model stationary-point candidate and produce bounded harmonic/thermochemical evidence.
preconditions: Geometry is optimized at the same method, basis, core, grid and solvent definition
Stationary-point intent, derivative route, masses, temperature, pressure and requested spectra are explicit
success_signals: all derivative subcalculations and SCF solutions converge
failure_semantics: Different-level/nonstationary geometry, unstable wavefunction, failed numerical displacement or unexplained mode blocks interpretation
Freq=ReadFC does not create or repair force constants
recipes.restart_semantics: Repeat failed derivative work only under a provider-documented exact checkpoint route; preserve the original output and identify every changed control.
scientific_acceptance: Inspect negative and near-zero eigenvectors
Declare scaling, symmetry, standard-state and low-frequency policies while preserving raw output

recipes.purpose: Diagnose one failed or suspect SCF/state solution and plan one causally motivated recovery child run.
preconditions: Failed input/log/checkpoint and last valid geometry are immutable and hash-bound
Charge, multiplicity, electron count, intended state, method/basis and failure pattern have been reviewed
success_signals: recovery proposal maps to the observed failure
official keyword behavior and operational heuristic are labeled separately
failure_semantics: Blindly stacking MaxCycle, XQC/QC, damping, shifting, Guess and NoSymm controls obscures causality
Convergence to a different/unstable state is not recovery
recipes.restart_semantics: Distinguish SCF=Restart, Guess=Restart and Guess=Read; select only the documented compatible path and retain parent-child lineage.
scientific_acceptance: Recheck occupations, spin, stability, energy, gradients and downstream observables after technical convergence

recipes.purpose: Optimize a local minimum candidate and compute same-level harmonic frequencies.
preconditions: Exact structure, charge, multiplicity, method, basis, resources, convergence policy, and checkpoint are frozen
The selected model chemistry is scientifically justified and converged for the target

required_sections: charge/multiplicity and Cartesian or supported molecular specification

expected_outputs: frequencies and thermochemistry requested by the route
success_signals: zero meaningful imaginary frequencies for the minimum intent
failure_semantics: Optimization failure blocks downstream frequency acceptance
Any meaningful imaginary mode blocks a minimum claim
Near-zero modes require explicit review
recipes.restart_semantics: Use a separately authorized Opt=Restart recipe only with the exact parent checkpoint.
scientific_acceptance: A local stationary point is not a global/conformer minimum
Thermochemistry requires temperature, standard state, scaling, and low-mode policy
Electronic-structure convergence remains observable-specific

recipes.purpose: Continue an interrupted optimization from its exact checkpoint lineage.
preconditions: Parent checkpoint bytes are available on the licensed platform and hash-bound
Parent input/log/revision/environment are recorded
The documented restart route is compatible with the parent
expected_outputs: updated checkpoint with explicit parent-child lineage
failure_semantics: Missing/wrong checkpoint or incompatible restart blocks the run
A restarted job inherits no scientific acceptance from the failed parent
recipes.restart_semantics: Each additional restart is a new lineage edge and requires a new authorization/output identity.
scientific_acceptance: Reapply final geometry and frequency gates after technical completion

recipes.purpose: Plan a transition-structure search, stationary-point check, and two-direction reaction-path validation.
preconditions: Reactant and product structures have identical atom ordering for QST2
Exact model chemistry and checkpoint lineage are frozen
Each job is separately audited/authorized

stages: IRC=RCFC or IRC=CalcFC in both directions

invocation.stdin_path: one audited stage at a time

expected_outputs: one intended imaginary mode and eigenvector
success_signals: exactly one meaningful imaginary frequency follows the intended coordinate
IRC branches connect the intended endpoints
failure_semantics: Wrong atom ordering invalidates QST2 input
Wrong mode count/eigenvector blocks transition-state identity
Missing or mismatched force constants block IRC
One-sided/unconverged/wrong-endpoint paths block reaction connectivity
recipes.restart_semantics: Use each task's documented restart with exact checkpoint ancestry; do not convert a partial path into a complete one by prose.
scientific_acceptance: Endpoint identities and competing paths require independent assessment
Kinetic claims require additional thermodynamic/dynamic assumptions

recipes.purpose: Follow both declared IRC branches from one frequency-verified transition structure and identify endpoint basins.
preconditions: The input geometry has exactly one intended imaginary mode
Exact Cartesian force constants are available through RCFC or will be computed through CalcFC
Direction/phase, point count, step size and model chemistry are explicit

invocation.stdin_path: one or two audited IRC stages

expected_outputs: forward and reverse path points with energies/reaction coordinates
success_signals: every path point has a converged intended state
both branches are continuous and long enough to enter endpoint basins
endpoint optimizations identify the intended structures
failure_semantics: Missing/mismatched Hessian, wrong phase/mode, unconverged point, too-short path, state discontinuity or unidentified endpoint blocks connectivity
recipes.restart_semantics: Use IRC=Restart only with the exact branch checkpoint and a new authorization/output identity; do not merge partial branches by prose.
scientific_acceptance: Optimize and frequency-characterize endpoints independently
One IRC does not establish all mechanisms or kinetic control

recipes.purpose: Compute and audit a bounded manifold of vertical TD-HF/TD-DFT excited states at one geometry.
preconditions: Ground-state reference is converged and its stability requirements are addressed
Spin manifold, NStates/energy window, target Root if any, basis diffuseness, functional and solvent response are explicit
expected_outputs: excitation energies, oscillator strengths, spin/symmetry and configuration evidence
success_signals: state count covers the target window
target state character is identified beyond root number
failure_semantics: Too few states, wrong manifold, root reordering, checkpoint-basis mismatch, ground-state failure or detached solvent convention blocks interpretation
A dark state is not automatically a solver failure
recipes.restart_semantics: Use TD=Read/Restart only with the exact compatible basis/state-space checkpoint and re-audit state identities after completion.
scientific_acceptance: Converge state window, functional, basis and solvent for the transition character
Separate vertical excitation from adiabatic, vibronic and emission observables

recipes.purpose: Optimize and characterize one intended TD excited state while auditing state continuity across geometries.
preconditions: A vertical calculation identifies the target state character
Root, NStates, method/basis/grid, solvent regime and state-tracking diagnostics are declared
The selected functional supports the requested derivative route

invocation.stdin_path: one audited TD stage at a time

failure_semantics: Root flipping, near-degenerate character exchange, unsupported derivatives, state/solvent mismatch or wrong stationary type blocks the result
recipes.restart_semantics: Restart only with exact TD/geometry checkpoint lineage and re-establish the same physical state; an unchanged Root number is insufficient.
scientific_acceptance: Separate vertical, adiabatic, zero-point and solvent-relaxation contributions
Converge state window and model chemistry for geometry and spectrum

recipes.purpose: Plan one checkpoint-consuming follow-up by resolving geometry, guess, basis, Hessian, TD-vector or restart roles explicitly.
preconditions: Parent checkpoint bytes, producer input/output, revision and environment are hash-bound
Every requested checkpoint record has a declared compatible consumer role

required_identity: parent checkpoint SHA-256 and byte count

success_signals: no consumer relies on filename-only identity
all retrieved fields and omitted input sections are explicit
failure_semantics: Wrong geometry/state/basis/Hessian/restart role, stale revision, detached producer or conflicting explicit input blocks the handoff
recipes.restart_semantics: Use the task-specific provider restart semantics; never generalize one Restart keyword across SCF, Guess, Opt, TD and IRC.
scientific_acceptance: Checkpoint reuse transfers data, not scientific acceptance; rerun every downstream task and model gate

recipes.purpose: Convert an exact binary checkpoint to a separately identified formatted checkpoint.
preconditions: Licensed Gaussian utility is available
Input checkpoint identity and disclosure policy are accepted
Output path is new and private
expected_outputs: case.fchk with separately recorded SHA-256 and byte count
success_signals: zero utility exit recorded by the trusted platform
nonempty output bound to the exact checkpoint
format/version expectations verified by an authorized consumer
failure_semantics: Missing/unreadable checkpoint or conversion error blocks use
Output existence does not prove correct parentage
recipes.restart_semantics: Regenerate into a new path from the same immutable checkpoint; never overwrite evidence.
scientific_acceptance: Conversion adds no independent scientific evidence

recipes.purpose: Generate a formatted electron-density cube from an exact formatted checkpoint.
preconditions: Authorized formatted checkpoint is bound to the accepted run
Density selector, grid policy, units, and disclosure policy are explicit

input_contract.grid: npts=0 requests the documented automatic 80x80x80 grid; do not treat it as a converged visualization grid

expected_outputs: density.cube plus recorded quantity/grid/unit/parent metadata and file hash
success_signals: requested quantity and parent identity match
failure_semantics: Wrong selector/grid/format/parent blocks analysis
An automatic grid is not numerical convergence evidence
recipes.restart_semantics: Regenerate into a new output after any selector or grid change.
scientific_acceptance: Record cube convention (primarily atomic units per the utility page)
Converge the grid and isovalue/analysis procedure for quantitative claims

recipes.purpose: Establish provider revision from a trusted execution record and exact bound output; no undocumented --version flag is assumed.
preconditions: Output bytes are bound to input/environment/authorization
The platform records the executable identity privately
expected_outputs: offline run-audit with observed revision and stable findings
failure_semantics: Filename, user prose, or an unbound banner is not version evidence
Revision mismatch blocks the registered profile
recipes.restart_semantics: Not applicable; re-audit immutable evidence after correcting only the evidence bundle.
scientific_acceptance: Version identity is necessary but does not validate a result
